classification_schema.PRODUCT_LEGACY_RUNTIME: Constructs an independent graph, owns the Product Run lifecycle, executes tools/models directly, or owns Plan / Final Gate / RunOutcome / Trace. BLOCKED.
classification_schema.PRODUCT_ADAPTER: Thin facade that delegates to the canonical Product Runtime (UnifiedAgentRuntimeService / SingleControllerRuntimeHarness / SingleControllerDurableRuntime / WorkspaceAgentRuntime / WorkspaceTaskRuntimeService). Does not construct an independent graph and does not directly execute models or tools. Allowed.
classification_schema.PRODUCT_CANONICAL: The canonical Product Runtime class itself (SingleControllerRuntimeHarness). Allowed by definition.
classification_schema.INTERNAL_TEST_HARNESS: Class definition exists but no Production Entry Point can construct or invoke it. Reachable only from tests/, evals/, docs/ or facade exports. Allowed today. Flips to PRODUCT_LEGACY_RUNTIME the moment a Production Entry Point starts constructing it.
classification_schema.INTERNAL_STEP_CAPABILITY: Step-internal mechanism (ReActStepRunner, StructuredResponseAgent) used inside the StepExecutionGraph. Allowed.
classification_schema.UNRESOLVED: Dynamic construction (globals/getattr/eval/__import__) whose target cannot be statically proven. Forces BACKEND_PRODUCT_RUNTIME_UNRESOLVED with non-zero exit.
